newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Charming Shoppes estimates lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Charming Shoppes estimates lowered.

text.p: - Gruntal Investment Research lowered its 1996 earnings estimate for Charming Shoppes to a loss of $0.04 per share from breakeven.
- Gruntal analysts said the retailer's third quarter net loss of $3.6 million was greater than anticipated, although the per-share loss of $0.03 was in line with the company's forecast.
- Charming Shoppes operates a chain of women's specialty stores.
- Charming Shoppes stock closed up 1/16 to 5-1/8.
